description: Step 1 of 3, before recommending any machine learning model or dataset. If compute, license, stack or data is missing, returns the questions to ask the user first: call again with the answers ("unknown" is fine). Then returns the method: split the ML need into parts, search Hugging Face and the other hubs for each with where_my_hug_search, and decide from what it finds which parts they cover (use a model as is, fine-tune one, train one) and which are plain code. Follow it.

compute.description: The hardware it has to run or train on, such as "one 24 GB GPU" or "CPU only". Size flags take the first "N GB" in it as the memory a model must fit in

data.description: Training data there is or could be, such as "none" or "about 300 labeled photos"

license.description: What the result may be used for, such as "commercial, closed source" or "research only"

need.description: The ML need in plain words: what goes in, what should come out, and what it is for

stack.description: What will call the model: language, runtime, framework

name: where_my_hug
title: Where my hug at?
